summary.text: Ron Alting, listed by Ballotpedia as Ronnie Alting, is a Republican Indiana state senator who has represented District 22 since 1998 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business development leader at Trane.

paragraphs.text: Alting earned a bachelor's degree from Purdue University and graduated from Lafayette Jefferson High School, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as founder, owner and manager of Patout's of New Orleans, Lafayette and as a key account specialist for Tipmont REMC.
He served as a captain, major and officer in the Indiana Guard Reserve and previously served as president of the Lafayette City Council.
Alting first assumed office in the state Senate in 1998.
For the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Public Policy Committee and is also assigned to the Insurance and Financial Institutions Committee.
